name: Qnity Electronics
description: Qnity (spun off from DuPont on November 1, 2025) sells the specialty materials used inside chip factories and in advanced packaging and circuit boards: CMP polishing pads and slurries, photoresists, cleaning chemistries, and dielectrics and plating chemistries for packaging and printed circuit boards. It earns revenue per unit of consumable material sold to chip makers and packagers, which are qualified into customers' process roadmaps and re-ordered as wafers are processed, so sales follow wafer starts and advanced-node and AI-chip packaging growth rather than equipment spending. FY2025 net sales were $4.75B (+10%), with Semiconductor Technologies 56% and Interconnect Solutions 44%, and segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA of 36% and 26% of sales respectively.
